response: NGA stands for "National Geographic Society." It is a non-profit organization that was founded in 1901 by the National Geographic Society. The organization is dedicated to promoting and preserving the natural world and the human experience through its publications, programs, and educational initiatives. NGA is known for its extensive collection of natural history and scientific articles, as well as its annual "National Geographic" magazine. The organization also has a wide range of educational programs and resources for schools, museums, and other organizations.
